# HL2601 — verification record + fixture (NOT a pipeline reference)

Strain HL2601: clinical non-O1/non-O139 *V. cholerae* from a bloodstream
infection, Xiamen, China (Frontiers in Microbiology 2026). Its 7-locus
MLST profile matched nothing in PubMLST; the curator assigned novel
ST2040. BioProject PRJNA1479141, BioSample SAMN60942877, SRA SRR39195233.

## What this fixture is — and is not

HL2601 exposed a typing-outcome gap: a species-confirmed genome whose
MLST profile matches no known ST surfaced as a bare `mlst_st: null`,
indistinguishable from a failed typing run. The response has two
parts: a lite-tier pattern label for non-pandemic V. cholerae (the
production watch path), and an assembly-tier tri-state typing outcome
(`mlst_call`: assigned / unassigned / not_interpretable, derived from
the raw MLST TSV crossed with the QC gate) with portal rendering.

This directory is a **verification record and test fixture only**. The
assembly is never a pipeline reference: no production path accepts a
deposited assembly (the assembly tier is Nanopore-only, enforced in
`report_lib.validate_platform_config` and the service validation), the
refs bundle does not carry it, and no test feeds it through the pipeline
expecting a classification. The end-to-end check for this strain belongs
to the lite tier run from its reads (SRR39195233) as a cohort
expectation — tracked as a follow-up, not built here.

## Files

- `MANIFEST.tsv` — the pinned-accession record (house manifest style):
  accession, gate facts, and the full marker verification.
- `genomic.fasta.gz` — the deposited assembly, byte-for-byte the NCBI
  Datasets genome fasta for **GCF_059628145.1**.
- `mlst.tsv` — tseemann/mlst-shaped row for this genome: scheme
  vcholerae, ST `-`, allele profile 51/41/4/79/72/1/83 (adk, gyrB, mdh,
  metE, pntA, purM, pyrC).
- `marker_refs.fasta` — the 2010EL-1786 reference alleles used as BLAST
  queries for the verification (ctxA, ctxB, tcpA, rtxA, hlyA at the
  `loci_2010EL-1786.bed` coordinates).

## Verification record (2026-10-15, before fixture entry)

Label claims checked against sequence content, per repo rule:

| Check | Method | Result |
|---|---|---|
| organism | NCBI Datasets report | *Vibrio cholerae*, tax_id **666**, strain HL2601 |
| completeness | CheckM v1.2.5 (NCBI report) | **99.28%** complete, 1.81% contamination |
| length | fasta stats vs repo gate constants | **4,297,354 bp** — inside ASM 3,800,000–4,400,000 |
| contigs | NCBI assembly stats (47 scaffolds, 4 internal N-gaps) | **51 contigs — EXCEEDS repo gate ASM_MAX_CONTIGS=50.** Recorded as fact; the gate was NOT retuned, and no fixture asserts a gate pass for this assembly. |
| N50 | NCBI assembly stats | 324,224 (gate min 200,000) |
| ctxA / ctxB | BLASTN two-tier screen (below) + PGAP GFF + 31-mer containment | **absent** — zero HSPs at evalue ≤1e-3; absent at strict (≥90% id / ≥80% cov) AND relaxed (≥70% id / ≥50% cov) tiers; unannotated in PGAP; containment 0.000. No relaxed-tier hit, so read-level confirmation was not triggered. |
| tcpA | same | **absent** — zero HSPs, both tiers clean |
| rtxA | BLASTN union coverage (14 HSPs) | **present** — gene coverage 1.000 at ≥90% id, best 98.20% id (≥80% gene-length coverage required for a present call) |
| hlyA | BLASTN | **present** — coverage 1.000, 99.15% id |
| MLST | per-locus exact match vs live PubMLST allele DB | 7/7 loci located, all exact known alleles; the *combination* is novel (paper: curator ST2040). Profile-table recheck is login-gated by PubMLST for post-2024 data. |

Two cautions baked into how this fixture may be used:

- **The oracle moves.** ST2040 exists in PubMLST now; a test pinned to
  live or bundled database state would flip without any code change.
  Tests here pin the *recorded profile and fixture measurements*, never
  a database lookup.
- **T6SS is not assessed.** It is a multi-gene system; representing it
  needs a curated locus decision (the loci BED is curated by hand and
  must not be regenerated by keyword). No T6SS claim is made anywhere in
  this change.
